trial_court: 2nd Additional District Judge, Ramanujganj, Civil Suit No.9-A/2019
case_name: Vinod Kumar Gupta vs Smt. Nidhi Gupta
facts_of_case: Petitioner filed an application under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 for grant of decree of divorce on the ground of cruelty. Respondent filed an application to set aside the ex parte proceeding drawn against Petitioner.

legal_principles.principle: In family matters, particularly in matrimonial disputes, the approach is radically different from that adopted in ordinary civil proceedings.
legal_principles.held: In view of the aforesaid material, in the family matters particularly, in matrimonial matters, the object of setting up of Family Court changed the approach radically different from that adopted in ordinary civil proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: The functioning of the Court may be restricted due to pandemic, and proceedings may be adjourned till further orders.
legal_principles.held: So the proceedings were adjourned till further orders.

outcome.final_order: Impugned order set aside, cost of Rs.200/- imposed on Respondent.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce on grounds of cruelty
responding to an application to set aside ex parte decree
guidelines for imposition of cost in divorce cases
